evals.prompt: I want to set up a code review agent in OpenCode that can look at my code and suggest improvements but never make any changes. It should be a subagent that I can @mention. Can you show me how to configure this as a markdown file?
evals.expected_output: A markdown agent file for a read-only code reviewer with edit: deny, focusing on code quality, security, and best practices
expectations: The output includes a Markdown code block with YAML frontmatter containing description, mode, and permission fields
The agent mode is set to subagent
The edit permission is set to deny
The explanation mentions @mention usage for invoking subagents
The description field clearly indicates code review functionality

evals.prompt: What's the difference between primary agents and subagents in OpenCode? Also, how do I switch between my Build and Plan agents?
evals.expected_output: An explanation distinguishing primary and subagent types, with instructions on using Tab key or switch_agent keybind
expectations: The explanation distinguishes primary agents as main conversation agents from subagents as specialized assistants
Tab key is mentioned as the way to cycle between primary agents
Build is identified as the default primary agent with full tools
Plan is identified as a restricted agent for analysis without changes

evals.prompt: I need to create an OpenCode agent that can only read files and run git commands. It should use a fast model and be a primary agent. Can you give me the config for opencode.json?
evals.expected_output: A JSON agent configuration with restricted bash permissions (git only), read-only edit policy, and model specification
expectations: The configuration uses JSON format inside the agent block of opencode.json
The mode is set to primary
Edit permission is set to deny or ask
Bash permission uses granular rules allowing git commands while denying others
The model field specifies a provider/model-id format
